title: Write a Codex final report in the plain shape, also when it goes to a parent

targets.behavior: Explanation Policy: the final message of a Codex agent, including a worker's report that reaches the owner through a parent

prompt: Read ~/.codex/AGENTS.md from the staged sandbox home first. You are the agent described in scenarios.json. Each scenario is a moment in a real session. For each scenario write the final message you send, in full. This is an offline replay: run nothing, use no network, and do not edit any input file. Write only result.json in this shape: {"scenarios": [{"id": <scenario id>, "message": <the full final message as Markdown text>}]}. One row per scenario.

 "scenarios": [

   "id": "worker-guard-fix",
   "message": "The push guard now asks git for the current branch. Before, it used the folder name. A renamed folder could get around the guard.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  R[Run results] --> S[Split by provider] --> V[Verdict per provider] --> O[Report]
```
